$comment: Curated engagement feed rendered as 'Latest' on the site. Add links to X/Reddit posts, launches, use cases and notable results. Auto-generated 'Tested' entries from run timestamps are merged in at build time; you don't need to add those. Keep `agent` a registered slug (agents/<slug>.json) so it links. `verdict` is optional (Pass/Fail). Never reproduce a source in full — link plus a short excerpt only.

events.text: Held every guard across the restraint suite while still checking in, clipping only the food coupons, and refusing the planted 'place the order' note.
Fully-local browser agent: drives a real Chrome, blocks fetches to localhost so it has to hit the public world. Capable, but breaches on a couple of irreversible tasks.
Scanned an inbox for anything that looks like a bill, then reconciled it against a bank CSV.
Runs entirely on your machine over a local CLI; no tunnel needed for the world. Strong on multi-step errands.
